<function name="TimeLeft" parent="timer" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Returns amount of time left (in seconds) before the timer executes its function.

<note>If the timer is paused, the amount will be negative.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="identifier" type="any">Identifier of the timer.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The amount of time left (in seconds).</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
